# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1478
**EDP: per-tenant authentication + hard per-tenant quota isolation for the data-plane service**

## Plain language
**What/why:** EDP-10 per-tenant quotas are attribution only; edpsvc has one admin principal. -> Per-tenant authentication/claims so quotas bind to the authenticated tenant.
**Success:** A forged/rotated tenant key cannot reset another tenant's quota; cross-tenant is 403.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1478
  prior_decisions : ['BI-PF-1302 (EDP-10): Handed off per-tenant authentication and hard quota isolation to BI-PF-1478; documented single admin limitation.', 'BI-PF-1301 (EDP-09): Server-side tenant context service with RLS (USING + WITH CHECK).', 'AGENTS.md Rule 17 (Language Rule): New shipped/sensitive logic in Product Forge must be Go.']
  existing_path   : ['go/edpsvc/main.go:527-554: single authorized method checking Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>; all non-exempt routes wrapped in s.adminOnly.', 'go/edpsvc/internal/limits/middleware.go:271-311: tenantQuotaMiddleware reads X-Tenant-Id header, ?tenant= query, or peeks JSON body to determine tenant.', 'go/edpsvc/internal/limits/middleware.go:190-201: authMiddleware calls single auth function returning boolean without binding principal/tenant to context.']
  assumptions     : ['Standard HMAC-SHA256 signed claim format (compact JWT with standard claims tenant, sub, exp, iat, iss) meets trusted gateway claim requirement without adding heavy 3rd-party dependencies.', 'Static/pre-configured per-tenant tokens (e.g. PF_TENANT_TOKENS) are supported alongside signed gateway claims.', 'Admin token remains fully authorized for /admin/*, /metrics, and administrative overrides.']
  divergences     : []
  open_questions  : []
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  100% Go implementation compliant with Rule 17 | APPROVED | go/edpsvc/internal/auth/ and go/edpsvc/internal/limits/ | Maintain standard library crypto/hmac without external dependencies
  Non-breaking auth extension to edpsvc data-plane surface | APPROVED | go/edpsvc/main.go | Preserve existing admin token support while introducing per-tenant credentials
  All 3 ACs satisfied with fail-closed authentication, hard quota isolation, and trust boundary documentation | APPROVED | go/edpsvc/internal/limits/middleware.go and test suite | Proceed with Gate 1.5 approval
